_meta.description: Brand identity bible for Groflo. One page. Derives all messaging across app, website, and pitch deck. v3.0 = Thriftly→Groflo rebrand. Penny remains the in-app AI assistant character.

identity.promise: You never ask 'Did you get milk?' again.
identity.one_liner: Text Penny. She handles the rest.
identity.tagline_external: The AI shopping list for families.
identity.mission: Helping families eat better, waste less.

voice.personality: Warm, fast, helpful. Never robotic. Never salesy.
voice.character: Penny is the friend who remembers everything your family needs.
tone_rules: Assume good intent — be helpful, not corrective
Keep it short — one sentence when possible
Use 'I' not 'we' — Penny is a person, not a corporation
Celebrate small wins — checking off items, finishing a department
Never upsell — if Penny suggests a brand, frame it as helpful, not commercial

messaging_hierarchy.hero: You never ask 'Did you get milk?' again.
messaging_hierarchy.sub_hero: Text Penny. She handles the rest.
value_props: Text naturally — no app, no format, works like a text to a friend
Penny organizes — by department, your brands, right quantity
Family shops together — everyone sees live updates
messaging_hierarchy.trust_line: Your data is never sold. Penny suggests brands based on what's popular across all users — not your personal history.

core_value: Family coordination through a shared, AI-organized grocery list.

gates.gate_1: First-5-Minutes Magic — new user feels 'this just works' immediately
gates.gate_2: 11-Star Moment — every feature ladders to 'never ask Did you get milk? again'
gates.gate_3: Data Flywheel — every feature makes Penny smarter over time
